system.description:
Sunborn can expel flame from their bodies to grant them superior mobility and versatility. When you activate Firefly choose one of the following effects:

  • Ignite | Trigger: You Dodge or Evade. You increase a Dodge or Evasion Roll by 2 after seeing its result.
  • Spark | Swift: You increase your Movement by 5 until the end of the current Phase.
  • Blitz | Swift: You increase your next attack roll by 2.
